title: Off-balance-sheet AI financing - the SPV leaseback / operating-lease rolling that keeps datacenter and chip debt off hyperscaler balance sheets
source: Public record: hyperscaler operating-lease + SPV structures that move datacenter/chip capex off the parent's balance sheet. Oracle FY2026 10-K + S&P (Jul 2026): ~$260B of additional (uncommenced) lease commitments expected to start FY2027-2029 + ~$13B unconditional purchase obligations, added by S&P to adjusted debt. Moody's (2026): ~$969B total future lease commitments across Amazon/Meta/Alphabet/Microsoft/Oracle, ~$662B of it uncommenced (~1.13x their combined adjusted debt). Amazon ~$8B chip-collateralized SPV (spec-chip-collateral-spv). Meta Hyperion (Louisiana) financed via a ~$27-30B SPV with Blue Owl (equity ~80%) + PIMCO-led debt, consolidated via the Beignet investor vehicle, kept largely off Meta's balance sheet (macro-cre-privatecredit, fin-meta-family). Apollo/Blackstone/Brookfield/KKR/BlackRock/Goldman named by NVIDIA to mobilize >$500B of third-party AI-compute capital, much of it insurance/annuity-funded private credit (spec-ai-compute-credit-risk). CoreWeave GPU-collateralized bankruptcy-remote SPVs ($8.5B 4th delayed-draw term loan; $2.6B loan with a Cash Trap Event). HONESTY/GRADE: the lease/SPV figures and the financier roster are FACT (filings + rating-agency tallies + reporting); the amounts are disclosed or rating-agency estimates as labeled; the 'this is circular / this is hidden leverage' read is LABELED interpretation (it is the BIS/Moody's/S&P framing, not a legal finding of concealment - operating-lease and SPV accounting is permitted under GAAP). This block carries a dedicated obs_edges ledger that is NOT ingested into the main financial graph (so the published financial SCC is unchanged); the core-robustness harness reads obs_edges to compute the circular core WITH vs WITHOUT the off-balance-sheet rolling. The main edges below are structural overlay only.

edges.notes: OBS financing is the mechanism by which datacenter capex is built and operated without sitting as debt on the hyperscaler parent - operating leases, SPVs, and JVs. Moody's tallies ~$969B of total future lease commitments across Amazon/Meta/Alphabet/Microsoft/Oracle (~$662B uncommenced, ~1.13x combined adjusted debt) (fact of the tally; 'hidden leverage' read = labeled, the agencies').

The chip-collateralized SPV leaseback (Amazon ~$8B; Apollo/Blackstone AI-XPV platform; CoreWeave GPU-backed delayed-draw term loans) is the hardware-level version of the same OBS rolling (fact; cross-ref spec-chip-collateral-spv + spec-ai-compute-credit-risk).

The capital behind the OBS vehicles is largely insurance/annuity-funded private credit (Apollo/Athene, KKR/Global Atlantic, Blue Owl, PIMCO, Brookfield) - the BIS 'shadow borrowing' warning is about exactly this off-balance-sheet layer (fact of the funding sources; systemic-risk severity = the BIS's assessment).

Oracle is the clearest named case: S&P added ~$260B of uncommenced lease commitments (FY2027-2029) + ~$13B unconditional purchase obligations to its adjusted debt in the Jul 2026 BBB- downgrade (fact; see spec-oracle-ai-credit-lynchpin).

Meta's Hyperion (Louisiana) datacenter is financed through a ~$27-30B SPV (Blue Owl equity ~80% + PIMCO-led debt, via the Beignet investor vehicle), structured to stay largely off Meta's balance sheet (fact of the structure; see fin-meta-family, macro-cre-privatecredit).

obs_edges.note: Amazon ~$8B chip-collateralized SPV: sponsor + rent for rented-out chip access, kept off Amazon's balance sheet (spec-chip-collateral-spv).
Return leg: the SPV delivers compute capacity back to Amazon under the leaseback - the leg that makes the structure circular (interpretation: circular; fact: the leaseback exists).
Oracle ~$260B uncommenced operating-lease commitments (FY2027-2029) + ~$13B unconditional purchase obligations, added by S&P to adjusted debt (Jul 2026).
Return leg: the leased capacity delivers Oracle's OCI/Stargate backlog (~$300B OpenAI RPO) - capacity out, revenue back (fact of the backlog; circular read labeled).
Blue Owl ~80% equity of the ~$27-30B Hyperion SPV (via the Beignet investor vehicle).
PIMCO-led debt tranche of the Meta Hyperion SPV.
The SPV funds construction of the Hyperion (Louisiana) datacenter.
Return leg: Hyperion delivers compute capacity to Meta under lease - off Meta's balance sheet (circular read labeled).
Meta's lease payments + residual-value guarantee back to the SPV - the cash-return leg that closes the Meta<->SPV loop (fact of the lease obligation; circular read labeled).
Apollo is a lead of the NVIDIA-named >$500B AI-compute financing roster; its Athene annuity capital funds the chip/DC SPV debt (spec-ai-compute-credit-risk).
Blackstone is one of the NVIDIA-named six arranging/financing AI-compute SPV capital (spec-ai-compute-credit-risk).

Athene (Apollo-owned) annuity/life premiums fund Apollo-originated AI-compute private credit - the insurance leg of the OBS stack; retirement liabilities downstream of GPU/DC collateral (fact of the flywheel; 'retirees bear the tail' = labeled).

CoreWeave GPU-collateralized bankruptcy-remote SPV ($8.5B 4th delayed-draw term loan; a $2.6B loan with a Cash Trap Event) - GPUs + customer contracts as collateral (spec-ai-compute-credit-risk, spec-coreweave-credit-stress-2026).
The SPVs buy GPUs from NVIDIA - closing the vendor-financing loop: NVIDIA-adjacent capital funds SPVs that buy NVIDIA chips (fact of the purchase; circular read labeled).
Microsoft share of the Moody's ~$969B hyperscaler future-lease-commitment tally (operating-lease datacenter capacity off balance sheet).
